study type: Bioinformatics/Computational study (data analysis, WGCNA, regression, GSEA, qPCR validation)
outcome: Preterm birth risk in preeclamptic pregnant women
cohort: The study analyzed publicly available data related to early-onset and full-term preeclampsia from an immunological perspective.
finding: The study identified four immune-related co-expressed genes (CXCR6, PIK3CB, IL1RAP, and OSMR) and constructed diagnostic and preterm birth risk prediction models for preeclampsia based on these genes.
